item.title: new font idea
item.description: So I have this idea for a font, but I don’t know if it’s already been done before. I want to atach some scans of some of the rough sketches of the alphabet for it, but I’m paranoid that someone will steal my idea. How would I find out if my idea has been done already? I try to search for keywords regarding the font, but I dont think its good enough. Should I just make the font anyway?
